text:
maya: Heads-up — UX/design ask for console analytics: product wants a single 'route snapshot' that captures per-route + per-model filters, selected saved query, and a light quota/cost preview. Thinking about how telemetry + routing policies map to that snapshot :thinking_face:
kevin: Sounds useful. Main questions: 1) snapshot schema for backend (what to store) 2) how to show quota preview without hitting heavy sampling/extra charges :money_with_wings:
rachel: For schema: store route_id, model_id(s) pinned, filter set (compact form), sample_window, and a computed cost_estimate token_estimate. Keep it tiny. Avoid storing full telemetry blobs. :+1:
sam: UX ask: quick toggle between "current live view" and "saved snapshot". Saved should show a delta badge if routing/quota changed since snapshot was taken. :eyes:
maya: Agreed. Also need an API contract for snapshots so Dedicated/Private can import/export. Proposal below: 
```json
{
  "snapshot_id": "s_12345",
  "route_id": "route-xyz",
  "pinned_models": ["redwood/fast-v1", "redwood/balance-v2"],
  "filters": [{"field":"status","op":"in","values":["succeeded","cached"]}],
  "sample_window_seconds": 3600,
  "token_estimate": 12400,
  "cost_estimate": 12.34,
  "created_by": "maya",
  "created_at": "2026-03-10T16:12:00Z"
}
```
kevin: That looks fine. A few notes: token_estimate should be optional and computed on demand if telemetry sampling rate is low. For Dedicated we can precalc. Also include a routing_policy_hash to detect if snapshot's routing would route to a lower tier model now.
rachel: +1 on routing_policy_hash. For UI: show a little warning if routing_policy_hash != current_policy_hash and allow "preview with current policy" or "preview with snapshot policy".
sam: Regarding quotas: we should avoid expensive queries. Idea: store a coarse precomputed quota_burn_rate (tokens/min) when snapshot is created, and show a projected 24h burn. Offer a button to "recompute now" that runs a lighter telemetry estimate endpoint.
ops-bot: Note: deploy-bot noticed a canary change to routing-policy-service v2 at 2026-03-09T23:01Z — potential impact on policy hashes. :rotating_light:
maya: UX mock note: in saved query card, show tiny chips: [models:2] [est cost:$12] [sample:1h] [policy:changed] and clicking policy chip opens diff.
kevin: API harrowing detail: how do we keep snapshots small? We shouldn't embed full model config. Use model refs + model_config_hash. Also store a lightweight filter fingerprint instead of full filter JSON for quick indexing.
rachel: For telemetry events: send SnapshotPreviewRequested with {snapshot_id, user, policy_mode} so we can track regressions after rollouts. Add metric labels: preview_type=(stable|snapshot|mixed).
sam: UX gating for rollouts: during model rollouts we should surface a "compatibility risk" flag on snapshots that pinned a model under rollout. Pull from rollout-service: if rollout_percent < 100 and snapshot pinned that model, show "at-risk" and offer automatic fallback to stable variant.
maya: Implementation checklist: 1) API proto for snapshot CRUD 2) small indexing table (route_id + snapshot_fingerprint) 3) lightweight estimate endpoint (+ quota recompute) 4) UI chips + policy diff modal 5) telemetry events + rollout checks.
kevin: I'll sketch the proto today. Quick sketch: POST /api/v1/snapshots -> returns snapshot_id. GET /api/v1/snapshots/:id?estimate=fast returns precomputed fields; ?estimate=live triggers recompute (rate-limited).
rachel: Also, add RBAC: snapshots on shared routes should be team-scoped. Metadata: visibility = personal/team/org.
sam: One more UX nit: when someone opens a snapshot from an older console version, and model refs no longer exist, show an inline fallback: "model not found — show closest compatible" with a small changelog.
maya: Love it. Anyone object to me drafting a short PR with the API shape + UI mocks tomorrow? :sparkles:
kevin: Go for it. I'll drop a proto and a sample curl in #eng-platform when ready.
rachel: I'll own telemetry events and metrics.
sam: I'll mock the policy diff modal.
ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance for telemetry indexing on 2026-03-15 02:00-03:00 UTC — previews may be stale during that window.
maya: Thanks — adding maintenance note to the snapshot docs. :thumbsup:
